conditions: Shared ESXi LAN runner, one vCPU, about 2 GiB RAM, XFS. One timed workload at a time on the runner, no cache drops or CPU/frequency/SMT/storage isolation. Workstation builds/tests run on a separate host. Ordinary caches; host load, network and storage scheduling uncontrolled. One artifact/output pair, independent QEMU and guest comparisons, then explicit checked cleanup before each next run.
